scope: minimum executable master contract for first static Meta Traffic/LPV PAUSED canary

canary_recipe.creative_media: existing static image after AssetSupply gate

separated_acts.validate_only: separate Meta read/validate act; roots only accepted receipt already exists
separated_acts.read_back: mandatory after each created veiculable step before advancing

flags.META_VALIDATE_ONLY_ENABLED: authorizes only remote validate_only, not durable receipt and not create
flags.META_CREATE_LEDGER_WRITE_ENABLED: authorizes durable validation/approval/step receipts; not dispatch by itself
flags.META_CREATE_PAUSED_ENABLED: authorizes dispatch/create only when ledger flag is also open
flags.reconciliation_read: must not depend on META_CREATE_PAUSED_ENABLED; may require ledger/read authority and Meta read credential

approval_contract: AssetSupply receipt ids/supply_sha256 for each selected asset
idempotency: identity is account_ref + step_name + resolved payload_sha256; plan hash alone is not enough
ambiguity_policy: after dispatch, timeout or unknown result becomes AMBIGUOUS; no automatic retry; absence/doubt remains manual for P0
